newsitem.title: USA: Global DirectMail sees Q1 EPS below views.
newsitem.headline: Global DirectMail sees Q1 EPS below views.

text.p: Global DirectMail Corp said Tuesday it expects first-quarter net income to be "in line" with profits posted in the fourth quarter of 1996 and the first quarter of 1996.
The company recorded per-share net income of $0.31 for both the first and fourth quarters of 1996, which the company said were the two strongest periods of the year.
First Call analysts' estimates projected per-share net income of $0.36 for the first quarter of 1997, while Zack's Investement Research forsaw $0.37 per share.
Global DirectMail said in a press release that it knew of no reason for the decline in its share price, which tumbled 7-1/2 to 20-1/2 before its stock was halted for trading around midday.
The company said it expects sales in the first quarter to "show growth" over the 1996 fourth quarter.
"The fundamentals of the company's business remain strong," Global DirectMail said it the announcement.
Global DirectMail Corp is a direct marketer of brand-name and private-label computer, office and industrial supplies.
